name: Battle of Megheddon Defile
description: The battle in which the Thran Alliance army was decimated and a killing mana cloud released.

description_citations.text: "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth wins the Battle of Megheddon Defile with the Null Sphere and drops a stonecharger on the fallen army.
timeline.quote: he drops a stonecharger , the magical equivalent of a nuclear warhead, on the fallen army.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Megheddon Defile the Alliance army is decimated and killing mana is unleashed using the Null Sphere.
timeline.quote: the Thran Alliance army was decimated by Yawgmoth's artificial and hybridized Phyrexian troops
